messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High error rate for HeliosCorp (private VPC) model endpoints — NLB target health flapping and 502s detected. Trigger: monitoring::nginx-502-rate > 5% for 3m. Paging eng-sre on-call.
maria (oncall): on it, acking. Can someone pull impact + last change?
raj (cust-eng): HeliosCorp reports ~18–25% 502s since 05:02Z. Dedicated customer, private VPC, endpoints served via tenant-dedicated pool behind an NLB in the customer's VPC. They see errors in app logs: `upstream prematurely closed connection` and timeouts.
tyler (eng-infra): looking. NLB target group shows 0/3 healthy for the model service. Health checks failing with TCP resets. Quick check of recent infra changes: a security-group rule change landed at 04:58Z from infra-deploy pipeline.
sam (net-oncall): can you paste the SG diff and healthcheck output? If this is SG we can open probe ports temporarily.
tyler (eng-infra): SG audit: `sg-0a1b2c3d modified by infra-deploy (ci-runner)` removed an ephemeral ingress rule that allowed our NLB health-check CIDR (10.10.0.0/22) to the target port 8080. Default service listens on 8080.
```bash
# truncated: describe-target-health output
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456:targetgroup/tg-helio/abcd1234
{
  "TargetHealthDescriptions": [
    { "Target": {"Id": "10.0.12.45", "Port": 8080}, "TargetHealth": {"State": "unhealthy", "Description": "TCP RST during health check"} },
    { "Target": {"Id": "10.0.12.46", "Port": 8080}, "TargetHealth": {"State": "unhealthy", "Description": "timeout"} }
  ]
}
```
leah (solutions): Helios says some traffic still gets through but a large fraction fails. They want a mitigation plan ASAP — they are on the phone with their SREs.
maria (oncall): plan: 1) temporary open SG for health-check CIDR to 8080 (sam) 2) if targets don't recover, fail traffic to customer's dedicated fallback pool (nate) with weighted DNS shift 3) roll back infra-deploy SG change and add guardrail to pipeline (tyler) 4) communicate to customer and keep them on the line (leah).
sam (net-oncall): opening SG now to allow 10.10.0.0/22 -> tcp:8080, will annotate change with ticket INC-6382.
```bash
# applied by sam
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 8080 --cidr 10.10.0.0/22 --description "temp allow healthchecks INC-6382"
```
tyler (eng-infra): SG rule added. Re-checking target health...
```bash
# re-run describe-target-health
TargetHealthDescriptions[0].TargetHealth.State = healthy
TargetHealthDescriptions[1].TargetHealth.State = healthy
TargetHealthDescriptions[2].TargetHealth.State = healthy
```
tyler (eng-infra): targets came back healthy within ~90s after opening SG. NLB traffic rates normalizing.
leah (solutions): customer confirms 75% reduction in 502s within last 3m. They still see a handful of errors but trending down.
nate (platform): preparing DNS weight shift (Route53) as a precaution to move 40% traffic to the dedicated fallback pool (dedicated-helio-pool) while we validate rollback. Will execute a canary for 2m.
```bash
# change batch (truncated)
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z3EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.helio.example","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"dedicated-pool","Weight":40,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z2LB...","DNSName":"nlb-dedicated-helio.example"}}}]}'
```
maria (oncall): roll back infra-deploy SG change as permanent fix + add CI check to prevent removal of healthcheck CIDR. Tyler, can you handle rollback and pipeline hotfix?
tyler (eng-infra): rolling back the specific commit in infra-deploy that removed the rule, will push a pipeline patch to require a healthcheck-tagged rule. I will also add an automated test that simulates NLB health checks in PRs.
oncall-rotation-bot: Reminder: on-call shift change in 50m.
maria (oncall): quick status: customer impact reduced, mitigation in place, targets healthy. Handoff plan: if anything degrades, page @sam and @maria. Otherwise, scheduled postmortem with Helios in 2 business days.
leah (solutions): I'll stay on the customer call for next 20m to verify. Put sync on their side for 09:30 local.
sam (net-oncall): permanent note — added SG guard to runbook and updated runbook with exact CIDR and port.
maria (oncall): clearing pages now. :white_check_mark: Final note for handoff: incident mitigated by SG rollback + temporary workaround; follow-ups: pipeline guardrail, postmortem with RCA, and a CI healthcheck test. Handoff to day shift (leah + nate) at 07:30Z.
incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigated. Incident timeline recorded to INC-6382.
maria (oncall): closing thread for now, will reopen if we see reoccurrence. Thanks everyone.
